incline_db_press.name: Incline dumbbell press
cues: Bench at 30°, feet planted, shoulder blades squeezed back
Lower until the dumbbells are level with your chest, elbows about 45° from your body
Press up and slightly in; don't clank the dumbbells

lat_pulldown.name: Lat pulldown
cues: Grip just outside shoulder width, thighs locked under the pad
Lean back slightly and pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows down to your sides
Control it up until your arms are straight; no swinging

seated_cable_row.name: Seated cable row
cues: Sit tall, slight bend in the knees, chest up
Pull the handle to your belly button, squeeze your shoulder blades together
Let your arms straighten all the way without rounding your lower back

machine_shoulder_press.name: Machine shoulder press
cues: Seat so the handles start at shoulder height
Press up without locking out hard or arching your back
Lower slowly to the start

cable_lateral_raise.name: Cable lateral raise
cues: Cable at the lowest setting, handle in the far hand
Raise out to the side to shoulder height, leading with the elbow
Lower for a slow 2 count; keep your torso still

rope_pushdown.name: Triceps rope pushdown
cues: Elbows pinned to your sides
Push down and spread the rope at the bottom
Only your forearms move; control it back up

cable_curl.name: Cable curl
cues: Stand tall, elbows by your sides
Curl up and squeeze at the top
Lower all the way down slowly; no body swing

leg_press.name: Leg press
cues: Feet shoulder width, mid-platform
Lower until your knees are around 90° without your lower back lifting off the pad
Push through your whole foot; don't lock your knees out hard

goblet_squat.name: Goblet squat
cues: Hold the dumbbell at your chest, elbows down
Sit down between your heels, chest up, knees track over toes
Drive up through your whole foot

rdl.name: Romanian deadlift
cues: Soft knees, push your hips straight back
Bar or dumbbells slide down your thighs; stop when you feel a big hamstring stretch
Squeeze your glutes to stand; back stays flat the whole time

walking_lunge.name: Walking lunge
cues: Long step forward, torso tall
Back knee drops to just above the floor
Push through the front heel into the next step

seated_leg_curl.name: Seated leg curl
cues: Line your knees up with the machine's pivot, lap pad tight
Curl all the way down and squeeze
Let it back up slowly to a full stretch

standing_calf_raise.name: Standing calf raise
cues: Balls of your feet on the edge, heels hanging
Drop into a deep stretch and pause 1 second
Rise as high as you can and squeeze for 1 second

cable_crunch.name: Kneeling cable crunch
cues: Kneel, rope by your ears, hips stay still
Curl your ribs down toward your hips by rounding your spine
Don't pull with your arms; exhale hard at the bottom

barbell_bench.name: Barbell bench press
cues: Eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pinched, feet planted
Lower to your lower chest with elbows about 45°
Press back up over your shoulders

db_bench.name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: Kick the dumbbells up, shoulder blades back and down
Lower to chest level, elbows about 45°
Press up and slightly in

neutral_db_bench.name: Neutral-grip dumbbell bench press
cues: Palms face each other the whole set (easier on the shoulder)
Lower to chest level with elbows tucked
Press up; stop if the shoulder pinches

chest_supported_row.name: Chest-supported row
cues: Chest stays on the pad the whole set
Pull your elbows back past your body
Pause, then let your arms fully straighten

chest_supported_db_row.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench
Row the dumbbells to your hips, squeeze your shoulder blades
Lower to a full stretch

pull_up.name: Pull-up
cues: Hands just outside shoulders, start from a dead hang
Pull your chest to the bar, elbows down
Lower all the way under control; stop 1–2 reps short of failure

assisted_pull_up.name: Assisted pull-up
cues: Pick assistance that lets you hit the rep range
Full hang at the bottom, chest to the bar at the top
Use less assistance as you get stronger

db_shoulder_press.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
cues: Back against an upright bench
Press from shoulder height to just above your head
Lower to ear level under control

landmine_press.name: Landmine press
cues: Bar end at shoulder height, staggered stance
Press up and forward along the bar's path
Shoulder-friendly swap for overhead pressing; lower slowly

face_pull.name: Face pull
cues: Rope at face height, thumbs toward you
Pull to your forehead, elbows high and wide
Pause and squeeze the back of your shoulders

incline_curl.name: Incline dumbbell curl
cues: Bench at 45–60°, arms hang straight down
Curl without letting your elbows drift forward
Lower all the way to a full stretch

oh_cable_ext.name: Overhead cable triceps extension
cues: Face away from the cable, rope behind your head
Extend your arms overhead, elbows pointing forward
Lower to a deep stretch behind your head

hack_squat.name: Hack squat
cues: Back flat on the pad, feet mid-platform
Lower as deep as you can with heels down
Drive up; don't lock your knees hard

ffe_split_squat.name: Front-foot-elevated split squat
cues: Front foot on a small plate or step
Drop the back knee straight down toward the floor
Push through the front foot; torso tall

hip_thrust.name: Hip thrust
cues: Upper back on the bench edge, bar padded on your hips
Drive through your heels until your hips are level with your knees
Chin tucked, squeeze your glutes 1 second at the top

leg_extension.name: Leg extension
cues: Knees line up with the machine's pivot
Kick up until your legs are straight, squeeze your quads
Lower slowly

lying_leg_curl.name: Lying leg curl
cues: Hips pressed into the pad
Curl your heels toward your glutes
Slow on the way down

hanging_knee_raise.name: Hanging knee raise
cues: Dead hang, no swinging
Curl your knees up toward your chest by tilting your pelvis
Lower under control

plank.name: Plank
cues: Elbows under shoulders
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs; body in one straight line
Breathe; stop when your hips sag

one_arm_db_row.name: One-arm dumbbell row
cues: Hand and knee on a bench, back flat
Row the dumbbell to your hip
Lower to a full stretch

band_pulldown.name: Band pulldown
cues: Anchor the band high
Pull elbows down to your sides
Control the band back up

db_lateral_raise.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
cues: Slight bend in the elbows
Raise out to the side to shoulder height
Lower slowly; no swinging

db_curl.name: Dumbbell curl
cues: Elbows by your sides
Curl and squeeze at the top
Lower all the way down slowly

oh_db_ext.name: Overhead dumbbell extension
cues: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands
Lower behind your head, elbows pointing forward
Extend back up

db_rdl.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Soft knees, hips back
Dumbbells slide down your thighs to a deep hamstring stretch
Squeeze your glutes to stand

bulgarian_split_squat.name: Bulgarian split squat
cues: Back foot on a bench, front foot far enough out
Drop straight down, front knee over the toes
Push through the front foot

sl_hip_thrust.name: Single-leg hip thrust
cues: Upper back on the bench, one foot planted
Drive the hips up through the heel
Squeeze at the top, keep hips level

sl_calf_raise.name: Single-leg calf raise
cues: Ball of one foot on a step, hold something for balance
Deep stretch at the bottom
Rise high and squeeze

dead_bug.name: Dead bug
cues: Lower back pressed into the floor
Lower opposite arm and leg slowly
Exhale and return; lower back never lifts

push_up.name: Push-up
cues: Hands under shoulders, body in one line
Lower your chest to just above the floor
Push the floor away; elevate your hands if needed

chin_up.name: Chin-up
cues: Palms facing you, shoulder width
Pull your chest to the bar
Lower all the way down

band_row.name: Band row
cues: Anchor the band at chest height
Row the elbows back past your body
Control it forward

arnold_press.name: Arnold press
cues: Start with palms facing you at chin height
Rotate the palms out as you press up
Reverse on the way down

rear_delt_fly.name: Rear-delt fly
cues: Hinge forward, flat back
Raise the dumbbells out wide with soft elbows
Squeeze the back of your shoulders

hammer_curl.name: Hammer curl
cues: Palms face each other
Curl without swinging
Lower slowly

close_grip_push_up.name: Close-grip push-up
cues: Hands just inside shoulder width
Elbows brush your ribs on the way down
Press up through your triceps

db_reverse_lunge.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
cues: Step back into the lunge
Back knee drops toward the floor
Push through the front heel to stand

db_hip_thrust.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
cues: Dumbbell on your hips, upper back on the bench
Drive up through your heels
Squeeze 1 second at the top

db_step_up.name: Dumbbell step-up
cues: Whole foot on the box
Drive through the top leg; don't push off the bottom foot
Lower slowly

sl_db_deadlift.name: Dumbbell stiff-leg deadlift
cues: Legs nearly straight, soft knees
Hinge at the hips to a deep hamstring stretch
Back flat; squeeze glutes to stand

lying_leg_raise.name: Lying leg raise
cues: Lower back pressed into the floor
Raise straight legs to vertical
Lower slowly without your back arching

back_extension.name: Back extension
cues: Pad just below your hips
Lower with a flat back
Squeeze your glutes to come up to a straight line

box_squat.name: Goblet box squat
cues: Box at a depth that's pain-free
Sit back to touch the box lightly
Stand up through your whole foot

machine_chest_press.name: Machine chest press
cues: Seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest
Press forward without locking your elbows hard at the end
Let the handles come back slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest

cable_fly.name: Cable chest fly
cues: Pulleys at shoulder height or above, one step forward, slight bend in the elbows
Bring your hands together in a wide hug, squeezing your chest
Open back up slowly; keep the same elbow bend the whole time

db_fly.name: Dumbbell fly
cues: Lie flat, dumbbells over your chest, slight bend in the elbows
Lower them out wide until you feel a stretch, not past your shoulders
Bring them back up in the same arc, like hugging a tree

back_squat.name: Barbell back squat
cues: Bar on your upper back, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out
Brace your core, sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel
Drive up through your whole foot, knees tracking over your toes

bodyweight_squat.name: Bodyweight squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width, arms out in front for balance
Sit back and down as low as you can with your chest up
Stand up by pushing the floor away; slow down, fast up

pike_push_up.name: Pike push-up
cues: Hands on the floor, hips high, body in an upside-down V
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor
Press back up; walk your feet closer to make it harder

bench_dip.name: Bench dip
cues: Hands on the edge of a bench or chair, fingers forward, legs out
Bend your elbows straight back to about 90°, shoulders down
Press back up with your triceps; bend your knees to make it easier

inverted_row.name: Inverted row
cues: Under a sturdy bar or table, body straight from head to heels
Pull your chest to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades together
Lower with control; bend your knees to make it easier

glute_bridge.name: Glute bridge
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body is straight
Squeeze your glutes for a second at the top, then lower slowly

skull_crusher.name: Dumbbell skull crusher
cues: Lie flat, dumbbells straight up, palms facing each other
Bend only at the elbows and lower the weights beside your head
Straighten your arms back up; keep your upper arms still

barbell_row.name: Barbell row
cues: Hinge forward to about 45°, back flat, bar hanging under your shoulders
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, elbows close to your body
Lower it with control; no jerking your torso up

hip_abduction.name: Hip abduction machine
cues: Sit tall or lean slightly forward, pads on the outside of your knees
Push your knees out as far as you can, squeezing your glutes
Control the weight back in; don't let the plates slam

cable_kickback.name: Cable glute kickback
cues: Ankle strap on, hold the machine, slight forward lean
Kick your leg straight back by squeezing your glute, not swinging
Return slowly; keep your lower back from arching

preacher_curl.name: Preacher curl
cues: Armpits snug on the pad, arms straight down the pad
Curl the weight up without lifting your elbows off the pad
Lower all the way down slowly; don't drop it

ab_wheel.name: Ab wheel rollout
cues: Kneel, hands on the wheel under your shoulders, core braced
Roll forward slowly as far as you can without your back sagging
Pull back with your abs, not your hips

bicycle_crunch.name: Bicycle crunch
cues: Lie on your back, hands lightly behind your head, legs up
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee as the other leg straightens
Switch sides slowly; twist from your ribs, not your neck

dip.name: Dip
cues: Hands on the bars, arms straight, shoulders down away from your ears
Lower until your elbows are about 90°, leaning slightly forward
Press back up; use the assisted machine or a band if you need help

seated_calf_raise.name: Seated calf raise
cues: Pad on your lower thighs, balls of your feet on the platform
Lower your heels as far as you can and pause in the stretch
Push up onto your toes as high as you can and squeeze

sl_rdl.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
cues: Stand on one leg, soft knee, dumbbells or hands in front of you
Hinge forward as your back leg lifts behind you, back flat
Stand back up by squeezing the glute of your standing leg

reverse_crunch.name: Reverse crunch
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent at 90°, hands by your sides
Curl your hips off the floor and pull your knees toward your chest
Lower slowly without letting your feet touch down

cable_woodchop.name: Cable woodchop
cues: Cable high and to one side, both hands on the handle
Rotate down and across your body, pivoting your back foot
Control it back up; turn from your trunk, not your arms

trap_bar_deadlift.name: Trap bar deadlift
cues: Stand in the middle of the bar, grab the handles, hips back
Brace, then push the floor away and stand up tall
Lower by pushing your hips back; keep the bar close and your back flat

leg_press_calf.name: Leg press calf raise
cues: Balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform, legs almost straight
Lower the platform with your ankles for a deep stretch
Press up onto your toes as far as you can and squeeze

decline_push_up.name: Decline push-up
cues: Feet up on a chair or couch, hands a little wider than your shoulders
Lower your chest to the floor in one straight line, elbows at about 45°
Press back up without letting your hips sag

slider_leg_curl.name: Slider leg curl
cues: Lie on your back, heels on a towel or sliders, hips lifted into a bridge
Pull your heels toward your butt while keeping your hips up
Slide them back out slowly; that slow part does most of the work
